correctness.rationale: For char(K)≠2, expanding N(x)N(y)-N(N(x)y+xN(y)-N(xy)) on all basis pairs first forces upper-right coordinates p=q=0 and then b(a-f)=c(d-f)=0 and bc+(a-f)(d-f)=0. The locus is precisely C1∪C2, two affine 5-spaces with common affine 3-space. On A/A² the bilinear product x1y2+x2y1 forces diagonal or anti-diagonal automorphisms (2q²(q−1)² over Fq). Exact conjugation separates four classes for each distinct repeated/simple eigenvalue pair and five for the equal-eigenvalue fiber, giving q(4q+1). Direct rank-one determinantal classification and inclusion–exclusion produce the published rank distribution and zeta function. Independently derived torsion identities, direct raw point/rank enumeration over F3 and F5, and full F3 conjugation gave 459/6125 raw points, 39 orbits; finite tests corroborate the symbolic proof, not substitute for it.
correctness.risk: Finite checks are scoped to their actual tested cases; unrestricted proof is analytical.
